messages:
anne: KestrelBank just pushed back on the renewal—needs a written delivery plan for Private (VPC) + CMEK + SLA guarantees. They want a firm timeline before they sign. Can we align scope and commit dates?

mike: quick q — when you say CMEK/HSM, which level do they require? CMEK via cloud KMS or an HSM-backed key?

sahil: engineering take: Private control plane + basic CMEK integration = ~6w (2 engineers). HSM support + formal SLA/perf tuning = additional ~4w. That's optimistic.

anne: Sales needs something we can put in SOW. If we do phases, customer might accept. What would a minimal Phase 1 look like to unblock the contract?

tanya: propose Phases: 
Phase 1 (MVP): Private control plane, CMEK (cloud KMS integration), basic observability, migration docs. Lightweight runbook. Target: 2026-05-15.
Phase 2: HSM option, SLA validation (p95 latency gating, runbook + monitoring), perf tuning and canary automation. Target: 2026-06-30.

mike: Phase 1 is doable if we shift a couple of engineers off the open-model onboarding work for 6w. Need 2 FTEs and 1 engineering lead. Also QA support for e2e.

sarah: QA add-on — plan includes +2w for e2e and compliance checks. So Phase1 realistic date becomes 2026-05-29 not 05-15.

kevin: from sales — Kestrel will accept phased delivery if Phase1 includes documented migration steps and a temporary SLA fallback (hosted fallback) while we finish Phase2. They want Phase2 by 06/30 though.

anne: customer insists on 06/30 for SLA. Can we promise an interim fallback and a written remediation plan if perf targets miss the first 30d? :thinking_face:

sahil: technically yes — we can ship Phase1 with CMEK + fallback to hosted path. For SLA we can offer an interim SLO of 99.5% for the first 30 days post-cutover and commit to 99.9% after we finish perf tuning (Phase2). Will need perf harness and load tests.

kevin: I'll relay that. They want the interim SLO + remediation clauses in the SOW. Can someone draft language?

mike: I'll draft the technical appendix for SOW (what we deliver, fallback behavior, rollback steps). Need product + legal review.

deploy-bot: created jira INFR-2314 "kestrel-private-kms-phased-rollout" assigned to mike, sahil -> https://jira.redwood/INFR-2314 :robot_face:

anne: Action items before EOD: mike -> RACI + SOW appendix draft; sahil -> perf test plan + smoke harness; kevin -> confirm customer will accept interim SLO and phased dates; tanya -> sync QA & CS on runbooks.

kevin: I'll confirm with Kestrel and push for written sign-off on phased dates (will update thread).

tanya: noted, I'll block QA time.

sarah: putting a tentative calendar invite for a sign-off sync next Tue 10am PT.

anne: thanks everyone. If we can get the SOW appendix and RACI by EOD, sales can include it in the renewal email. :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks — ping me if you need customer-side examples of acceptable SOW language.

anne: (cc) @mike @sahil @tanya @kevin @sarah
